Flexibility: 5

Elaboration: 5

Cultural Sensitivity: 5
Justification: It is deeply culturally attuned, explicitly mapping interventions to cultural dimensions like power-distance and GDPR legacy, and utilizing localized champions and team-based gamification to navigate regional anxieties effectively.
